en.Beschreibe das Problem möglichst konkret: Describe the issue as specifically as possible.
en.Beschreibe dein Problem — das Helpdesk-T: Describe your issue — the helpdesk team will get back to you as soon as possible.
en.Das Helpdesk-Team kontaktiert dich über: The helpdesk team will contact you at the provided email address.
en.Das Helpdesk-Team nimmt dein Ticket an u: The helpdesk team will accept your ticket and get back to you by email.
en.Das Ticket erscheint sofort in der Warte: The ticket will appear immediately in the queue with status "New" and can be assigned to a staff member.
en.Das Ticket kann nun einem Agenten zugewi: The ticket can now be assigned to an agent or provided with a note.
en.Das Ticket wird sofort dem gewählten Age: The ticket will be immediately assigned to the selected agent and set to 'In Progress'.
en.Das Ticket-Team sieht die Notiz im Verla: The ticket team sees the note in the ticket history.
en.Der Agent erhält die Zuweisung. Über „No: The agent will receive the assignment. Use 'Add Note' to provide additional information about the ticket.
en.Die Notiz wird sofort am Ticket gespeich: The note will be saved to the ticket immediately and is visible in the ticket detail.
en.Ein offenes Ticket einem Agenten zuweise: Assign an open ticket to an agent and set the status to 'In Progress'.
en.Ein offenes oder laufendes Ticket auswäh: Select an open or ongoing ticket to be assigned.
en.Eine interne oder für den Melder sichtba: Add an internal or reporter-visible note to an open ticket.
en.Einen aktiven Agenten wählen. Ein Team i: Select an active agent. A team is optional.
en.Einen neuen Support-Auftrag in drei Schr: Create a new support ticket in three steps.
en.Kein Asset gefunden. Schritt kann übersp: No asset found. This step can be skipped.
en.Keine offenen Tickets gefunden. Alle Tic: No open tickets found. All tickets are already closed.
en.Keine offenen Tickets vorhanden. Alle Ti: No open tickets available. All tickets are closed or resolved.
en.Name oder Seriennummer suchen …: Search by name or serial number …
en.Nur offene Tickets werden angezeigt — be: Only open tickets are shown — already closed ones are hidden.
Optional — assign ticket to a team.
en.Text verfassen und festlegen, ob die Not: Compose text and specify whether the note should be visible to the reporter.
en.Titel oder Meldername suchen …: Search by title or reporter name …
en.Um was für ein Problem handelt es sich?: What type of issue is it?
en.Was hast du versucht? Seit wann besteht: What have you tried? How long has the issue been occurring?
en.Welches Gerät oder welche Ressource ist: Which device or resource is affected? This step can be skipped.
en.Wer meldet das Problem und was ist passi: Who is reporting the issue and what happened?
